decisions.reason: The product builds on the firm's existing fine-material and carpet-related knowledge, supporting assimilation of market feedback and continuous improvement.
Its closeness to the established decorative carpet range allows the firm to interpret early results and apply related knowledge, making withdrawal unlikely.
The corner bench extends the firm's established furniture expertise, giving high absorptive capacity to learn and refine the product.
As a low-pile carpet close to the existing offer, the firm can leverage its material know-how to assess and improve performance.
The swivel shell chair line draws on the firm's established seating and design capabilities, enabling effective learning and incremental enhancement.
